'''Ark Roose's Podracer''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] owned by [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. He piloted the Pod during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] won by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Characteristics==
The Pod was powered by two [[Plug-8G 927 Cluster Array engine]]s, consisting of sixteen engines in two clusters. The Podracer accelerated quickly, it was very fast and delivered easy engine cooling methods such as an open-air channel in the middle of the vehicle. What the Plug-G had in speed, it lacked in handling and turning, so it often held the advantage on straight courses.
